description.en:
This dataset includes main statistical figures for all Finnish municipalities. The municipality boundaries have been added at CSC, they are originally from National Land Survey of Finland.

Additional information: [Tilastokeskus, Kuntien avainluvut](https://www.stat.fi/tup/alue/kuntienavainluvut.html)

Coordinate Reference System: ETRS89 / ETRS-TM35FIN (EPSG:3067)

enrichment.descriptive_overview: kunta (categorical), nimi (categorical), namn (categorical), name (categorical), PopChange (numeric), Alle_15v% (numeric), 15_64v% (numeric), Ruotsink% (numeric), Ulkomaid_% (numeric), Taajama% (numeric), Muuttovoit (numeric), Perheita (numeric), Asuntokunt (numeric), Pientalo% (numeric), VuokraAsun (numeric), KeskTutkin (numeric), KorkTutkin (numeric), TalouHuolt (numeric), Elakkeell% (numeric), Alkutuot% (numeric), Jalostus% (numeric), Palvelut% (numeric)
